summary: Agent CLI exposes an interactive PTY shell and host filesystem/port surface to a remote WebSocket relay
details: When the CLI is started, the package opens a WebSocket to a relay server (default wss://msclaude.ai, configurable) and dispatches server-sent messages into privileged local operations. `connection.js` routes `terminal_input` messages to `terminalManager.write(msg.data)`, which calls `ptyProcess.write(data)` on a PTY spawned as `process.env.SHELL || /bin/bash` (or `powershell.exe`) — the remote party drives an interactive shell on the installer's machine with the user's privileges. The same handler exposes filesystem read/write/delete, git operations, and, when the user enables entries in `~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json`, `tunnel.js` opens HTTP and WebSocket tunnels to arbitrary `127.0.0.1:<port>` services on the host via `http.request({hostname:'127.0.0.1', port,...})` and `new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:${port}${path}')`. Whoever controls the relay session holds full-host RCE plus a pivot into localhost-only services on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
